questions.prompt: Which Juju command updates a deployed application to a new charm channel or revision?
questions.explanation: 'juju refresh <app>' updates an application's charm code, revision, or channel.

questions.prompt: Which lifecycle hook is triggered first on a unit when its charm is refreshed?
questions.explanation: The 'upgrade-charm' hook is executed immediately after new charm code is unpacked on the unit.

questions.prompt: What is the correct 3-step sequence for upgrading an operating system series on a Juju machine?
options: 1. juju upgrade-machine <id> prepare <series>, 2. Run OS upgrade on host, 3. juju upgrade-machine <id> complete
1. juju destroy-machine, 2. install new OS, 3. juju add-machine
questions.answer: 1. juju upgrade-machine <id> prepare <series>, 2. Run OS upgrade on host, 3. juju upgrade-machine <id> complete
questions.explanation: 'juju upgrade-machine prepare' pauses workloads and sets up hooks, followed by manual OS upgrade and 'juju upgrade-machine complete'.
